## A true story...

- You are a newly hired data scientist with visualization superpowers, expert coding skills in R, Python, Excel (Visual Basic), SAS, SPSS, Tableau, PowerBI
- You are given a dataset and you begin to explore it
- You kind of know what you're looking for, but you don't know what you're going to find yet
- You work with your bag of tools through the available resources

## Visualization is an iterative process

::: {.notes}
-   Don't expect your visualizations to require just one attempt.
-   As you will see throughout the course, the process is very iterative
    -   e.g. (0) Create (1) modify (2) re-render (3) re-evaluate ... repeat until satisfied
:::

![](https://flowingdata.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/visualization-process-720x561.jpeg){fig-align="center"}

## Practice, practice, practice

::: {.notes}
-   This process may sound easy but it requires significant practice and attention to detail
-   With time, you will be able to identify and correct previously un-noticed aesthetic issues
:::

![](https://media.giphy.com/media/Y2c1ZjXVHRdSr1YojF/giphy.gif){fig-align="center"}
